name: Ling 3.0 Tiny
license: Proprietary (open-source release planned but not yet published)
archDisplay: Sparse MoE, 7.9B total / 1.3B active parameters, switchable Thinking/Instant reasoning modes, designed for edge and on-device deployment
note: inclusionAI's (Ant Group) lightweight edge-deployment model in the Ling 3.0 series, positioned below Ling-3.0-flash: only 1.3B activated parameters for real-time interaction, lightweight code assistance, local knowledge-base retrieval and tool calling with low latency on constrained hardware. Ant's own docs say it 'will be open-sourced in the near future' as of launch, so it currently ships closed/proprietary; served free of charge (promotional) via OpenRouter at launch with no confirmed first-party metered price, hence price: null here.
